title: Every profiled finite-cutoff Gaussian has a strict unrestricted quartic residual descent

residual_descent.finite_cutoff_setting: Fix N and g>0. Let G_N be a normalized nondegenerate real Gaussian and H_N=H_(0,N)+gW_N on the finite real Q-space.
residual_descent.nonzero_residual: (H_(0,N)G_N)/G_N has degree at most two, while W_N has a nonzero quartic homogeneous part. Hence r_N=(H_N-<G_N,H_NG_N>)G_N is nonzero: no such Gaussian is an eigenfunction.
residual_descent.ritz_matrix: With sigma_N=||r_N||>0 and u_N=r_N/sigma_N, the exact compression to span{G_N,u_N} is [[lambda_G,sigma_N],[sigma_N,mu_N]] and its lower eigenvalue is strictly below lambda_G.
residual_descent.symmetry: For K1572's translation-invariant Gaussian, H_N commutes with translations, so r_N and the descending Ritz vector are translation invariant.
residual_descent.finite_cutoff_consequence: K1572's exact stationary diagonal Gaussian minimum is strictly above the unrestricted translation-invariant finite-cutoff infimum.
residual_descent.scope_guard: No cutoff-uniform lower bound on the Ritz gap is proved; the result does not change h_g^prof on K1577's class, determine the unrestricted coefficient, or decide bounded-error recentering.
